run.name: Elanco Animal Health Inc
run.title: CP-OS host session (ELAN)
run.summary: Elanco is a moderately leveraged, improving credit with adequate liquidity and no large maturity before 2028. Its weak point is leverage quality: 3.91x on total debt, add-backs of USD 236 million and claims outside the debt table. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context.

revenue.basis: Revenue, as the CP-1 table prints it.

ebitda.basis: EBITDA, reported reconciliation, as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Debt at 2026-06-30 is gross debt 3,944 including the 255 finance lease; cash 530; trailing Adjusted EBITDA 1,008 as printed (Aug release page:14). Net debt here is 3,414. The company's own net leverage, deducting the finance lease too, is 3.1x. Adjusted EBITDA is a management measure that excludes covenant adjustments

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. Adjusted EBITDA 901 over cash interest paid 206 (10-K page:112), net of 43 received on net investment hedges; before that receipt the cover would be 3.62x on 249

cash.basis: Cash. Undrawn is about 750 revolver plus about 165 securitization capacity (Q2 10-Q page:36). Same borrowing base caveat. A significant part of cash is held outside the U.S. (page:36); the split is not supplied

cashflow.basis: Cash from operating activities, as the CP-1 table prints it.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Executed debt documents, achieved covenant ratios, ratings and any evidence after 2026-08-05 are not in the pack.
CP-1 main limitation: Adjusted EBITDA is a management measure; trailing cash interest and achieved covenant ratios are not supplied; the latest balance sheet is June 30, 2026.
